newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer calls on Bonn to reach credible policy.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer calls on Bonn to reach credible policy.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer on Thursday called on the German federal government and local governments to agree to a credible fiscal policy.

Tietmeyer said the measures were needed to strengthen Germany as an industrial centre and to create security for investors. He said there was a need for "individual responsibility" and greater private initiative in Germany.

Tietmeyer said in the text of a speech to a Goldman Sachs conference in Frankfurt that the measures were needed to help combat "intolerably high" German unemployment and reform pension programmes. --Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525
